label: Meeting Minutes Generator
description: Transforms meeting notes or transcripts into formatted minutes. Structures: attendees, agenda items, decisions made, actions agreed (with owners and deadlines), and next steps.

claudeKnowledge.description: Formal meeting minutes conventions, corporate governance meeting documentation, board minutes standards

guidedInputs.label: Meeting details
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Date, time, location/platform, meeting name or reference.
e.g. AMLR Steering Committee — 19 February 2025, 09:00-11:00, Teams video call

guidedInputs.label: Attendees
guidedInputs.placeholder:
List attendees with name, role, and organization where relevant. Note any apologies.
e.g.
Present: Johan Andersson (CFO, Chair), Lisa Berg (CTO), Anna Lindqvist (Compliance Director), Karl Svensson (PM, openEXPERT), Maria Ek (Data Lead)
Apologies: Erik Nilsson (Legal)

guidedInputs.label: Meeting notes or transcript
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Paste your meeting notes, transcript, or bullet-point record of the discussion. The quality of the input determines the quality of the minutes — include: key discussion points, decisions made, and actions agreed with owners.

e.g.
- Reviewed status report — project is amber. Vendor delay 6 weeks.
- Agreed to escalate to programme board next week if vendor doesn't confirm recovery plan by Friday
- Lisa to chase IT infrastructure team about environment readiness — done by 21 Feb
- Anna raised concern about data quality report — needs more detail on error rate by system
- Karl to produce breakdown by source system by Monday
- Next meeting: 5 March same time
